d.ko: An ink-wash, single-player xianxia sandbox RPG. Each year in seclusion passes for the world too, as old friends break through or pass away. Build a cave abode, tend spirit fields, raise a family, tame spirit beasts, or join a sect and duel your way up. When your years run out, an heir carries on.

d.zh: 《归墟行：人界篇》是一款水墨风单机修仙沙盒 RPG。你闭关几年，世上便过去几年，故人或破境，或坐化。开辟洞府、侍弄灵田、开炉炼丹，结为道侣、生儿育女、收服灵兽，也可拜入宗门、亲手斗法，自炼气修至化神。寿元尽了，自有子女或徒弟接着走下去。
